mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60d returns in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, prompting the Fed to raise rates and depressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20d returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in RSAFS (reserves) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a tightening of monetary conditions and reduced liquidity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases AND RSAFS decreases > 1% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS falls by >1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in GDPC1 and HOUST above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60d returns in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average combined with a fall in UNRATE below 4% signals a softening labor market, which reduces wage inflation and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds its 12mo MA and UNRATE falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low CPIAUCSL below 2% for four consecutive months signals a prolonged period of low inflation, which increases the probability of prolonged low interest rates and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 60d returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for four consecutive months.
